name: print-social-radiating-sun-poster-like-light-from-the-sky
title: Cyan poster with cream radiating rays and giant black 'LIKE LIGHT FROM THE SKY' scattered around the sun
whatItIs: A cyan poster with a large cream sun and thick radiating rays, four short lines of small black text stepping across the centre, and a giant heavy black 'LIKE LIGHT FROM THE SKY' scattered in single words that the rays cut through.
whatItMeans: Bright and optimistic; the rays slice the letters like light.
techniques: Draw a sunburst from thick rays.
Scatter giant words across the rays.
Step small text lines across the sun.
Use only cyan, cream and black.

vocabulary.definition: A phrase split across a poster.
Rays passing over and cutting letters.
